methodology.launch: CF_CFC_PREPARE_LADDER=1 CF_CFC_PREPARE_REPS=1 CF_CFC_PREPARE_START_REP=<1|2|3> CF_CFC_PREPARE_OUT=<arm-directory> deno task integration patterns cfc-prepare
methodology.execution: Isolated integration toolshed/shell servers; no Loom. Explicitly dispose prior browser runtime before navigation to prevent CPU profiler selecting stale idle workers. Fresh piece for every observation.

runtimePosture.evidence: Harness logs record serverExecution=false; author runtime explicitly declares enforce-explicit/persist; shell uses existing enforce-explicit/persist defaults.

methodology.boundary: Visible duration starts at native button click event (browser performance.now), ends when MutationObserver-driven predicate sees exactly N expected bubble elements with nonzero layout boxes and visible display/visibility. Pre-settle and target marking outside timer. No post-click runtime idle or view settle drives the measurement. StepTimer independently records click dispatch plus DOM-wait wall time.
methodology.profile: attachWorkerProfiler/startWorkerProfile/writeWorkerProfile; V8 worker samples with prepareCfc anywhere in parent chain form CFC bucket. Each repetition has nonzero prepareCfc samples. Inclusive function breakdowns overlap and must not be summed.
methodology.counters: before/after worker getLoggerCounts snapshots; counts are differences. Logger baselines reset before interaction. scheduler/run/action and scheduler/run/commit totals are worker milliseconds. Statistics sampled immediately after profile stop, so an asynchronous tail may extend beyond the first visible frame.
methodology.load: uptime load averages recorded independently for every raw row.
methodology.slope: Ordinary least squares log(median event-to-visible milliseconds) against log(N), four size medians.
methodology.labelFence: awaitViewSettled after event-to-visible, profile, counters and load snapshots, before all property/label reads.
methodology.readme: compare-browser.py reproduces the exact normalized full snapshot comparison. Raw row files and profiles remain in each arm directory.
methodology.fixture: N message rows seeded with labeled messages.payload. SELECT thread_id AS id, (json_group_array(json(payload) ORDER BY id) || '') AS packed FROM messages GROUP BY thread_id. SQL finishes before timing. PerSession selection lift returns row reference; parseThread JSON.parse lift consumes ParseRow whose packed field declares same Confidential atom as source; natural bubbles.map JSX creates conditional class and text.
methodology.assertions: Each rung checks all N visible texts/classes, exact source packed value-class label, exact root+length carried views, positive text slot value/followRef confidentiality, positive resolved text/class carried labels, author resolved statuses and strict refused transaction exact reason. Full cross-arm snapshots then compared without removing integrity.

limitations: Explicit parser-input Confidential<string,["cfc-prepare-messages"]> repeats source policy. Without this declaration, current baseline and final source observes:value label is carried by selector as followRef, but parsing output and VNode labels are absent. This independent propagation boundary is diagnosed in /tmp/cfc-round2-aggregate-diagnosis.json; this change does not fix it.

The SQLite driver auto-decodes JSON subtype74; SQL || empty-string forces text to satisfy the intended JSON.parse boundary. Original aggregate without this coercion produces an array and fails the declared string projection identically in baseline/final.
Timing covers warm SQL row selection to visible output, not SQL aggregation/seed startup.

Root VNode resolved stored views are absent for session output, and author-runtime status is absent/readFailed=false. Worker text-slot views and full resolved carried text/class views are positive and compared exactly; inline text target bare stored view is absent.
Profiles include native-dispatch overhead outside exact event-to-visible interval; statistics may include asynchronous tail. Inclusive function buckets overlap.
Visible means nonzero boxes and visible CSS, not every bubble simultaneously inside viewport.
CFC share is whole profiled open, not a separately delimited instantiation transaction.
Per-observation uptime recorded and arms alternate by repetition; independent machine activity can still affect latency. Only v4 directories are final actual-SQL evidence.

equivalence.normalization: Only address id strings beginning of: are consistently renamed by first-seen identity, and space strings consistently renamed; this preserves alias topology. Strict refusal target normalized by test. Every other field, including integrity identity/codeHash/moduleIdentity, observation class, path/scope, schema, inline-data URI, text/class and full reason, is exact.

mapArgumentUsageFollowup.fix: Use existing schemaPathSelection; retain declared/open/legacy arguments. Fix helper base+branch combination with combineSchema, retaining explicit outer properties and structural schemas.
baselineInvestigationFindings: The emitted operation body reads only element.me and element.text. Its object argument schema declares only element and does not set additionalProperties:false.

inferListOpArgumentUsage calls ContextualFlowControl.getSchemaAtPath for index/array/params. Executing it against the exact emitted schema returns true for all four flags; each missing schema path resolves to {}.

ContextualFlowControl.schemaAtPath defaults defaultMissingProperty=true; with nonempty properties and a missing property it selects that default. getSchemaAtPath converts true to {}, which is not undefined.

map.ts:createRunInput includes array:listCell whenever usesArray is true, and passes that input for every created child. Thus the browser lowering has the same whole-array argument-carriage mechanism as the conservative builder case.

The initial emitted-schema diagnostic preceded the final aggregate ladder. It establishes inclusion of the unused array, but does not allocate each term of the observed cover-count formula to a particular link kind. Final aggregate counts and paired runs are recorded under cardinality and arms.

Pattern construction (builder/pattern.ts:597) sanitizes with sanitizeSchemaForLinks(argumentSchema, KeepAsCell.All); the diagnostic executed that exact sanitizer too. It leaves this emitted schema unchanged and sanitized argument-usage inference remains all true.

aggregateDiagnosis.cause: SQLite driver eagerly parses JSON-subtype aggregate into array; ThreadRow.packed:string projects row away, preventing parsing lift. Row exists in storage and query reports pending:false without error.
aggregateDiagnosis.secondaryBoundary: Without explicit parser-input policy, source row packed observes:value secret -> selector [0,packed] observes:followRef secret -> bubbles and every VNode label absent on both baseline/final. Separate ParseRow packed:Confidential<string,[same source atom]> on parser lift input restores output confidentiality, no startup refusals.
